result.summary: Found two issues: an incorrect navigation selection and low-contrast text.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted even though the page displays the Home restaurant feed.
issues.suggestion: Highlight Home as the active tab, or display the Profile page when Profile is selected.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom-navigation labels have low contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text and icons to meet applicable contrast requirements.
